description: This PHP class 'ConfigBuilder' constructs and manages configuration objects for a documentation generation tool, including loading configuration files, setting override values, resolving themes, and initializing settings.

classes.name: ConfigBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating and configuring 'Config' objects with methods for setting various configuration options, loading files, and resolving themes.

methods.name: fromFile
methods.description: Loads and unserializes a Config object from a file.

methods.name: withMode
methods.description: Creates a new ConfigBuilder with a specified mode and loads base configuration.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Merges provided values into the Config object.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a nested value in a Config array based on a dot-notated key.

methods.name: withValues
methods.description: Sets override values to be applied during build.

methods.name: withDocumentationDirectory
methods.description: Sets the documentation directory path.

methods.name: withValidContentExtensions
methods.description: Sets valid content file extensions.

methods.name: withThemesPath
methods.description: Sets the themes path.

methods.name: withThemesDirectory
methods.description: Sets the themes directory.

methods.name: withCache
methods.description: Enables or disables caching.

methods.name: withFormat
methods.description: Sets the output format.

methods.name: withConfigurationOverride
methods.description: Specifies a file for configuration overrides.

methods.name: withProcessor
methods.description: Sets the processor option.

methods.name: withConfluenceDelete
methods.description: Configures Confluence delete option.

methods.name: withConfluencePrintDiff
methods.description: Configures Confluence print diff option.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes configuration, applies overrides, and returns the Config object.

methods.name: resolveThemeVariant
methods.description: Resolves theme and variant based on theme directory existence.

methods.name: initializeConfiguration
methods.description: Performs setup tasks like validating paths, loading configs, and setting timezone.

methods.name: normalizeThemePath
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the theme path.

methods.name: normalizeDocumentationPath
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the documentation path.

methods.name: loadBaseConfiguration
methods.description: Loads default and global configuration files.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads and merges a JSON configuration file.

methods.name: getConfigurationOverride
methods.description: Retrieves the override configuration file path if exists.

methods.name: findLocation
methods.description: Finds the actual location of a given path, relative or absolute.
